exl3_lane.engine: exllamav3 1.4.7 wheel (exllamav3-1.4.7+cu128.torch2.10.0, CPython 3.12), staged in isolation from the lab's pinned 1.4.3 and loaded through PYTHONPATH
exl3_lane.library_environment: E7-E49 and the E32/E41/E42 conversions ran with LD_LIBRARY_PATH pointing at a system CUDA 12.1 toolkit, so libcublasLt 12.1 and libnvrtc 12.1 were loaded beside torch's bundled 12.8 libraries ('mixed' set). E50 and E51 ran with LD_LIBRARY_PATH unset; their loaded libraries are recorded per run in data/rows/EFF-h38*_cuda_libs.txt.
exl3_lane.e51_development_branch: exllamav3 dev branch at 08849e3 (1.4.9-dev), built in place against torch 2.10.0+cu128 with nvcc 12.6
exl3_lane.daily_driver: replication/serving/tabby-daily.yml: EXL3 SC_2.00bpw_H3, MTP draft (dynamic, draft_num_tokens 6), max_batch_size 1, 32K context, Q8 cache, chunk_size 1024, 16 GB recurrent stash; launched by replication/serving/launch.sh with EXL3_CKPT_PP=1024 and LD_LIBRARY_PATH unset
lab_patches: replication/patches/exl3_all_lab_patches.patch (complete generator patch including EXL3_CKPT_PP / EXL3_CKPT_GEN; apply this once, plus only the architecture section of exl3_spec_sampled.patch; see FULL_RERUN.md)

gguf_lane.engine: llama.cpp v0.4.0 (ggml-org/llama.cpp tag v0.4.0, commit 5266f24da75dc449bd56cbed7addb9c8e4a6a73e), CUDA 12.6, sm_89
gguf_lane.lab_patch: replication/patches/llamacpp-v0.4.0-qwen35-mtp-shared-embd.patch (working-tree diff of the patched v0.4.0 checkout used for the stripped MTP sidecar, E12, E18, E20, E22, E38, E48)
